requirement: Redis applications shall be able to use Redis Proxy with either standalone or clustered Redis storage. The proxy shall accept supported Redis commands, automatically synchronize applicable instructions among participating agents, and forward supported writes to the configured Redis storage. It shall provide cluster-aware routing and support commands in the String, Set, List, Hash, Sorted Set, Stream, and basic control categories within the declared command-support scope.

Applications shall be able to publish and subscribe using Redis-compatible semantics across a decentralized multi-node network. PubSub shall support communication between nodes on the same network, on different networks, and behind NAT or in private networks, using Kademlia DHT with libp2p/IPFS-style peer discovery and routing.
